Name: An Older and Depressed-Looking Shane
Author: lolmariam
Description:
[center]I love the original 16-bit style that Stardew Valley has for their portraits.

However, I feel like some of the NPCs portraits didn't look appropriate: for Shane, I felt like his portrait made him look too young and neat.

In my portrait mod, I based off of the portrait that CA created but modified it to give him a more chiseled jaw, a different nose, slightly darker stubble, straighter brows, and messier hair. This, in turn, makes him look older, actually depressed, and slightly more attractive.

I also fixed the jacket (got rid of the holes and stuff) and removed the logo because 1) he hates that place so why would he wear it all the time (especially when he already gets into uniform when he's at work?) and 2) because even if you [b][i]*spoilers*[/i][/b] complete the community center, he wears the jacket when Joja Mart is closed. SO BYE LOGO. 

This is my first time creating portraits like this so I edited it several times until it felt decent. 

If there's any issues with it, please let me know. I tested it out in my game and it seemed to work fine.[/center]



[u][b]To use this mod, you need to install the following mods: [/b][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK - Patonymous Toolkit[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]



[u][b]Here's how to install the portrait mod:[/b][/u]

﻿[color=#f1f1f1]Put the .png images inside the Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\lolmariam folder on your computer. [/color][i]This is where you keep your portrait mods created by me. (When you download Portraiture, it will create a folder. In that folder, there is a Portraits folder. For each different group of portraits that you want to toggle from, create a named folder to separate them.)

[/i][color=#f1f1f1]To switch the portraits and reveal the modded version, press P in-game during a dialogue with said NPC. [/color][i]It should keep that portrait throughout the game until changed again.
[/i]

[color=#f1f1f1]If there are any issues with the portrait mod (including alignment or quality), please contact me.

[i]This mod has only been uploaded to NexusMods.com.
